modules.name: SBV Silverbox Voice
modules.description: 303-style acid bass voice: curved saw and shaped square, diode ladder, accent sweep, slide, bass comp and key track.

modules.name: SBS Silverbox Sequencer
modules.description: 303-style acid sequencer with separate pitch and time programming, 64 patterns, 7 tracks, scramble and mutate.

modules.name: SBX Silverbox Extended
modules.description: Expander for SBV with extended 303 mods: VEG decay, accent decay, slide time, soft attack, sweep speed, filter FM, overdrive, muffler.

modules.name: SBO Silverbox Oscillator
modules.description: 303-style acid oscillator with the lid off: curved saw, pulse width and PWM, sub-octave, wavefolder, hard sync, linear FM, drift and board trimmers.

modules.name: SBF Silverbox Filter
modules.description: 303-style acid filter, envelopes and VCA: diode ladder with LP/BP/HP, accent level input, gate trim and the board's fixed values as trimmers.

modules.name: SBT Silverbox Tuner
modules.description: Scala microtuning for any 1V/oct signal: eight scale slots, keyboard mappings, built-in scales, polyphonic.
